# Medicamentos PLM

> > Comprehensive pharmaceutical reference database and clinical decision support platform serving healthcare professionals across Latin America with drug information, active substance monographs, and specialized tools for pediatrics, gynecology, and maternal nutrition.

Medicamentos PLM is the digital evolution of the Diccionario de Especialidades Farmacéuticas (DEF), providing evidence-based pharmaceutical information through multiple specialized platforms including PLM Medicamentos, PLM Pediatría, PLM CT Ginecología, and PLM Nutrición Maternal. The platform serves as a critical resource for medical professionals and patients seeking reliable drug information in Latin America.

## Key Topics

- PLM (Para Los Médicos)
- Diccionario de Especialidades Farmacéuticas (DEF)
- PLM Medicamentos
- PLM Pediatría
- PLM CT Ginecología
- PLM Nutrición Maternal
- Pharmaceutical reference database
- Clinical decision support tools
- Active pharmaceutical substances
- Healthcare professionals resources
- Patient education materials
- Digital pharma marketing
- Medical information platform
- Latin America pharmaceutical data

- [Inicio | Medicamentos PLM](https://medicamentosplm.com/): Homepage for PLM pharmaceutical reference database and clinical tools
- [Inicio | Medicamentos PLM](https://www.medicamentosplm.com/): Main page for DEF drug dictionary and pharmaceutical information resources
